text:
deploy-bot: Canary deploy started for release v2.14.0 to prod. 50 users, region=us-west-2. Change window until 2026-03-20T21:30Z. Rollback runbook: https://confluence.redwood/internal/runbooks/deploy-backout-v2 :rocket:
jen: copying the runbook link to channel, thanks. who’s watching metrics?
kai: I’ll tail infra alerting. if latency > 200ms for 3m we trigger failover.
marta: can we confirm the pin for the model binary? tag: `model@2026-03-18-9f2b`
sam: confirmed pinned to `model@2026-03-18-9f2b` on dedicated pools. no auto-promote.
jen: good. ops checklist:
```
- validate canary traffic split (50/50)
- watch error_budget and p95 latency
- have backout branch ready: release/v2.14.0-backout
- SSH access for oncall: ops@redwood
```
kai: seeing slight increase in decode latency, p95 +30ms but within threshold. continuing.
sre-bot: ALERT: anomaly detected in kv-cache hitrate (us-west-2) — drop 12% in last 2m.
marta: that KV hit drop aligns with the model quantization change. opening checklist item 3.
jen: decision call — do we proceed or execute escape route? we should be ready to unwind if error budget dips below 5%.
sam: we should stage the rollback command — don’t run yet. putting the command here for ops-runbook:```bash
deployctl rollback --to-tag v2.13.9 --services apiserver,runtime --reason "kv-cache regression"
```
kai: +1. I’m on the metrics console and will flag at 2m if trend continues.
marta: if we decide to backout, follow runbook step 4: canary pin revert -> scale down canary pool -> route traffic to v2.13.9. runbook: https://confluence.redwood/internal/runbooks/deploy-backout-v2#steps
jen: update — error budget at 4.7% (5m window). calling for rollback in 30s unless it stabilizes. :warning:
sam: staging rollback now (dry-run succeeded). I have the commit SHAs and release notes ready.
sre-bot: NOTE: automatic fallback policy available: route-policy=regional-fallback. use `--fallback-region=us-east-1` to immediate failover if needed.
kai: trend is still rising. I vote for backout.
jen: executing backout in 10s. inform support and product. @marta @sam please prepare release notes patch.
marta: copying support message: "Rolling back v2.14.0 canary due to KV cache hit regression. Impact: potential increase in inference latency for ~5% of traffic during rollback window." :white_check_mark:
jen: backout started. will post logs.
deploy-bot: Backout initiated by jen. Rollback job id: rb-2165432100-01. Estimated time: 4-7m.
jen: logs: `rb-2165432100-01` succeeded on apiserver, runtime. canary traffic drained. verifying p95 and error budget now.
kai: p95 back to baseline within 3m. error budget restored to 9.2%.
sam: released patch notes update: added rollback rationale and next steps. uploading to release tracker.
marta: follow-up action: open a postmortem checklist item to investigate quantization profile inversion. assigning to eng-ml.
jen: thanks everyone. closing thread when docs and postmortem ticket created. :thumbsup:
